source_text: Circumdatur Hiericho — non gladio sed tubis sacerdotalibus muri subruuntur. Hiericho figura mundi; homo de Ierusalem in Hiericho descendit — Adam. Caeci in Hiericho — ignorantiae caecitas. Consummatio saeculi tubis: Canet tuba et mortui resurgent; Dominus in tuba Dei descendet. Meretrix sola salvatur — ecclesia exploratores suscipiens, nunc uni viro casta Christo. Fuistis haec; sed abluti sanctificati estis. Spartum coccineum — Christi sanguine ecclesia salvatur. Cui gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Is-surrounded Jericho — not by-sword but by-trumpets priestly walls are-overthrown. Jericho figure of-world; man from Jerusalem into Jericho descended — Adam. Blind in Jericho — of-ignorance blindness. Consummation of-age by-trumpets: Will-sound trumpet and dead will-rise; Lord in trumpet of-God will-descend. Harlot alone is-saved — church spies receiving, now to-one man chaste to-Christ. You-were these; but washed sanctified you-are. Cord scarlet — by-of-Christ blood church is-saved. To-whom glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: Jericho is circled — walls fall not by sword but by priestly trumpets. Jericho figures this world; [[the man who went down from Jerusalem to Jericho >> Bible:Luke 10:30]] images Adam. The blind in Jericho image ignorance’s blindness. The age ends by trumpets: [[The trumpet will sound and the dead rise >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:52]]; [[the Lord will descend with God’s trumpet >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 4:16]]. Only the harlot is saved — the church that received the spies, now [[a chaste virgin to one husband, Christ >> Bible:2 Corinthians 11:2]]. [[Such were some of you, but you were washed and sanctified >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:11]]. The scarlet cord — the church is saved by Christ’s blood. To him be glory. Amen.
